title: The keyboard never gets around permission or status limits
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A view-only user and prohibited-status work orders.
custom_steps:
1. As a view-only user, try to reach and trigger drag/reassignment using only the keyboard.
  2. Confirm the keyboard cannot perform an action the user lacks permission for.
  3. As a create-and-edit user, try to reassign a prohibited-status work order by keyboard and confirm it is blocked.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Keyboard access never bypasses action permissions or work order status restrictions.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10054 — Story 11 Keyboard access and focus. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S11-N1 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
